title: bzf costs
description: The costs of a roadmap's measures, `costs/<id>.json`: investment, the share of it that would be due anyway (Sowieso-Kosten, `anywayCosts`), and the funding each may get, as estimated at a date. Commercial: it never leaves the organisation that holds it, so a roadmap shared with a trade goes without it. The issued roadmap shows these figures as they were. This schema describes documents of schema version 1.x; a document of another major version is only required to say which.

roadmap.description: The roadmap whose measures it prices.

date.description: The price basis: when the costs were estimated.

anywayCosts.description: The part of the investment that would be due anyway, as repair or replacement, without the renovation (Sowieso- or Instandhaltungskosten).

maintenanceYearly.description: What keeping it in order costs a year once done (EPBD Annex VIII 2(b)(vii)): servicing, inspections, wear.

rate.description: The funding rate, as a fraction, bonuses included.

source.description: Where the figure came from: an offer among the received files, a cost database.
